scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Medical Equipment And Accessories, Medical Diagnostics And Ayush Products Manufacturing Units
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The unit must be a new or existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Commercial production must commence between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027
The enterprise must apply through the online portal within one year from the date of first disbursement of loan or on or before the date of commencement of commercial production
benefits_summary: Provides a 20% capital investment subsidy up to ₹5,000,000 per unit and a 60% credit‑linked interest subsidy up to ₹5,000,000 per year for up to five years.
